moments.title: Calculator discussion

ican.text: I can explain the main ideas and use the notation for graphs of functions and sketching.
I can apply these ideas, show my working and check the result.

ku.text: A graph shows the points $(x,f(x))$ for inputs in the domain.
A root is an $x$-intercept where $f(x)=0$; the $y$-intercept is $f(0)$ if defined.
Use a suitable graphing window and check important features numerically.

misc.weak: Assuming no root exists because it is outside the viewing window
misc.better: Adjust the window and use algebra or a solver to check.

terms.text: Give a reason that connects the mathematical idea to the situation.
Show enough working to make your method and answer clear.
